dedupe_keys.name: fhwa weather data environment wxde road weather observations from fixed and mobile sources

description: The Weather Data Environment (WxDE) is a Federal Highway Administration research system that collects and shares transportation-related weather data, with a focus on data for connected vehicle applications. Contents: real-time observations from state environmental sensor stations and mobile sources, with quality-check results for each observation, inferred road weather from vehicle data, and road weather forecasts up to six hours ahead from the integrated Pikalert and METRo modules, shown as alerts on road segments. Coverage: US states that contribute data; each state's collection status is shown on the map. Format and access: a web map, a report query by contributor, station, observation type and time range with CSV, XML and CMML downloads, and scripted subscriptions at set intervals; registration is needed for reports and subscriptions. Licence and cost: free; no licence was stated, and contributors may restrict some data. Caveats: a research system whose coverage depends on state contributions. Useful for hazard exposure and emergency response models of roads in winter storms. It relates to NOAA MADIS and the Danish road weather feeds in the catalogue.
